feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: This legendary board game could take decades to complete
entry.summary: Andy Taeger & James Purcell are trying to become the first people ever complete the board game Campaign for North Africa. The is so complex it could take decades to finish.

entry.title: Chile's Valparaíso: where old songs find new voices
entry.summary: In Chile's storied port city of Valparaíso, a new generation is breathing life into boleros, waltzes and cueca, blending the city's musical traditions with sounds of today.

entry.title: Democrats are running on affordability. Are voters buying it?
entry.summary: Republicans started the year believing tax cuts would benefit them in the midterms. Instead other affordability issues are driving voters to Democrats.

entry.title: Willie the pony treats hospital patients with medicine for the soul
entry.summary: Sometimes hospitals invite special guests to come visit patients in an effort to boost spirits. One "mane" attraction at an Ohio hospital is Willie Nelson- the pony.

entry.title: Political conspiracy movies from the past can help us understand our current moment
entry.summary: Political conspiracy films peaked in the 1970s. What do those films offer at a time when conspiracy theories flood social media and are repeated by the president and other politicians?

entry.title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
entry.summary: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

entry.title: Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan Senate race, spurning Abdul El-Sayed
entry.summary: Rep. Haley Stevens was scheduled to attend a unity event today with Abdul El-Sayed, who beat her in the Democratic primary. Instead, she endorsed his Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

entry.title: Devastating storms continue to hit Southwest 'Four Corners' region
entry.summary: Communities in the Southwest are bracing for more flooding this weekend. This follows weeks of devastating storms that have pummeled parts of the region.

entry.title: What a midterm race in Kentucky says about how Democrats may do in Trump strongholds
entry.summary: Democrats are putting up a fight in midterm races this year that went for President Donald Trump by double digits in 2024. Kentucky Public Radio's Sylvia Goodman explains what we can learn from one Kentucky district.

entry.title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
entry.summary: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?
